points: Your site offers 10% off the first order, yet 0 of 28 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with that offer in line one and print 10% off on the creative.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead three new ads with it on the creative.

4 of 28 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so the creator’s voice gets lost among your other ads. Whitelist those four from the creator account, then cut three variations of the best one.

Your 28 copy ads open with 19 different stories, and the biggest opens only 3 ads. Pick the two strongest openers and build the next batch from them, three ads each, so the account repeats one clear idea.
